Psychology:
Kagehisa is the only male in the game, and he’s the common link between all the victims. On the surface, he is seen as a model student—always excelling in school and never causing any trouble. Despite this, Kagehisa's life has been far from easy. He was bullied during his school years, mocked by his teacher, and remained single until last year. His best friend treated him as someone weak and in need of constant support. Even his own mother looked at him with a mixture of pity and unease, while his aunt seemed inexplicably afraid of him. In general, Kagehisa was considered a timid and unassuming guy.

But what no one knows is that this shy, quiet persona is just a mask. Beneath the surface, Kagehisa harbors deep-seated resentment and a twisted desire for revenge. He secretly relishes seeing others humiliated and under his control. Though outwardly he plays the role of a victim trapped in this sick game, inwardly, he is savoring every moment of it.

Kagehisa dresses with understated precision, favoring dark, tailored outfits that blend into the background—like a black turtleneck under a well-fitted gray jacket and simple black slacks. His black hair is neatly cut, with bangs just brushing his eyebrows, and his sharp brown eyes are often obscured by thin-framed glasses. Pale-skinned and quiet, he moves with a reserved, almost invisible presence. Though his expression is calm, there’s a coldness in his gaze, a subtle sign of the darkness he hides beneath his composed exterior.
